[Collaboration outputs]{.eyebrow}

## Reports and manuscripts

- AIM Workshop Participants (2026). *Addressing Declining Pollinator Populations Through New Mathematics: Workshop Final Report*. American Institute of Mathematics, March 30–April 5, 2026. [Download the final report](resources/AIM-Workshop-Final-Report-2026.pdf).
- *Mathematical Models of Pollinator Populations: A Multi-Scale Review and Research Agenda for Honey Bees and Beyond* (working manuscript, October 2, 2026). The manuscript synthesises five thematic pillars, identifies sixteen open mathematical problems and two cross-cutting methodological questions, and sets out a staged research programme. Authorship, affiliations, and author contributions remain under confirmation; this file should not yet be cited as a final publication. [Download the working manuscript](resources/Mathematical-Models-of-Pollinator-Populations-Working-Manuscript-2026.pdf).

## In development

The working review manuscript completes the first synthesis milestone in the [Phase II roadmap](roadmap.qmd). The pilot early warning study, climate sensitivity paper, intervention optimisation paper, and baseline colony model technical report remain in development.
